_meta.scope: Per-chart consolidated expectations for MangalDoshaInfo + KaalSarpDoshaInfo + SadeSatiInfo for 12 reference natives. Yoga panels + Pitru Dosha are OUT OF SCOPE: the reference almanac does not surface them.
_meta.natal_corpus: Reuses the Phase 29 AstroSage R-tier corpus (testdata/charts/astrosage-charts.json). Source URLs preserved per-chart.
_meta.expected_value_derivation: Structurally derived from the reference almanac's stated rule sets applied to AstroSage R-tier natal positions. No library output was consulted, so the derivation is anti-circular.
_meta.almanac_scrape_status: The reference almanac's kundali / mangal-dosha / kalasarpa-yoga / sadesati pages are form-only POST pages: no GET scrape interface exists (empirically verified 2026-05-11). Per-chart almanac panel verdicts would require manual form-entry recording per native; this fixture instead pins structural-rule-set-derived expectations and locks the library's faithful implementation of those rules.
_meta.tolerance: MangalDoshaInfo/KaalSarpDoshaInfo bool/int fields: exact. SadeSatiInfo arc boundaries: ±2 days. Cancellations: set-superset (library may surface additional reasons the canonical derivation skips).
_meta.asOf_for_sadesati: 2026-05-04T12:00:00Z, Saturn in Meena. Same anchor as tests/validation/phase29-sadesati-validate.test.ts.
